source.text: וַיִּתְחַתֵּ֣ן שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה אֶת־פַּרְעֹ֖ה מֶ֣לֶךְ מִצְרָ֑יִם וַיִּקַּ֣ח אֶת־בַּת־פַּרְעֹ֗ה וַיְבִיאֶ֨הָ֙ אֶל־עִ֣יר דָּוִ֔ד עַ֣ד כַּלֹּת֗וֹ לִבְנ֤וֹת אֶת־בֵּיתוֹ֙ וְאֶת־בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֔ה וְאֶת־חוֹמַ֥ת יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם סָבִֽיב׃

records.literal_gloss: And made himself son-in-law Solomon with Pharaoh king of Egypt, and took [the] daughter of Pharaoh and brought her to [the] city of David until he finished building his house and [the] house of Yahweh and [the] wall of Jerusalem all around.

en.L: And Solomon became son-in-law to Pharaoh king of Egypt; and he took Pharaoh's daughter and brought her into the city of David until he had finished building his own house and the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and the wall around Jerusalem.
en.B: Solomon made a marriage alliance with Pharaoh king of Egypt. He married Pharaoh's daughter and brought her to live in the city of David until he had finished building his own palace, the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and the wall around Jerusalem.
en.R: Solomon made a treaty with Pharaoh, the king of Egypt, by marrying his daughter. He brought her to live in the oldest part of Jerusalem, called the city of David. She stayed there until Solomon finished building his palace, the temple of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and the wall all around Jerusalem.

es.L: Y Salomón emparentó con el faraón, rey de Egipto; y tomó a la hija del faraón y la trajo a la ciudad de David, hasta que acabó de edificar su casa y la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} y el muro de Jerusalén alrededor.
es.B: Salomón hizo una alianza matrimonial con el faraón, rey de Egipto. Se casó con la hija del faraón y la llevó a vivir a la ciudad de David, hasta que terminó de edificar su propio palacio, la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} y la muralla alrededor de Jerusalén.
es.R: Salomón hizo un tratado con el faraón, rey de Egipto, casándose con su hija. La llevó a vivir a la parte más antigua de Jerusalén, llamada la ciudad de David. Ella se quedó allí hasta que Salomón terminó de construir su palacio, el templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} y la muralla alrededor de Jerusalén.

fr.L: Et Salomon devint gendre de Pharaon, roi d’Égypte ; et il prit la fille de Pharaon et l’amena dans la cité de David, jusqu’à ce qu’il eût achevé de bâtir sa maison, et la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, et la muraille autour de Jérusalem.
fr.B: Salomon s’allia par mariage avec Pharaon, roi d’Égypte. Il épousa la fille de Pharaon et la fit habiter dans la cité de David, jusqu’à ce qu’il eût achevé de construire son palais, la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} et la muraille qui entourait Jérusalem.
fr.R: Salomon a fait une alliance avec Pharaon, le roi d’Égypte, en épousant sa fille. Il l’a fait habiter dans la partie la plus ancienne de Jérusalem, qu’on appelait la cité de David. Elle est restée là jusqu’à ce que Salomon ait fini de construire son palais, le temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, et la muraille tout autour de Jérusalem.

sw.L: Sulemani akajifanya mkwe wa Farao mfalme wa Misri; akamtwaa binti Farao, akamleta katika mji wa Daudi, hata alipomaliza kujenga nyumba yake mwenyewe na nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na ukuta wa Yerusalemu kuuzunguka.
sw.B: Sulemani alifanya mapatano ya ndoa na Farao mfalme wa Misri. Akamwoa binti Farao, akamleta akae katika mji wa Daudi mpaka alipomaliza kujenga ikulu yake, nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, na ukuta wa kuuzunguka Yerusalemu.
sw.R: Sulemani alifanya mkataba na Farao, mfalme wa Misri, kwa kumwoa binti yake. Akamleta akae katika sehemu ya zamani zaidi ya Yerusalemu, iitwayo mji wa Daudi. Akakaa huko mpaka Sulemani alipomaliza kujenga ikulu yake, hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, na ukuta wa kuuzunguka Yerusalemu yote.

vi.L: Sa-lô-môn làm con rể Pha-ra-ôn vua Ai Cập; vua cưới con gái Pha-ra-ôn và đưa nàng vào thành Đa-vít cho đến khi vua xây xong cung điện mình, nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và tường thành bao quanh Giê-ru-sa-lem.
vi.B: Sa-lô-môn kết thông gia với Pha-ra-ôn vua Ai Cập. Vua cưới con gái Pha-ra-ôn và đưa nàng về ở trong thành Đa-vít cho đến khi vua xây xong cung điện của mình, nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, và tường thành bao quanh Giê-ru-sa-lem.
vi.R: Sa-lô-môn kết liên minh với Pha-ra-ôn, vua Ai Cập, bằng cách cưới con gái của Pha-ra-ôn. Vua đưa nàng về ở trong khu cổ nhất của Giê-ru-sa-lem, gọi là thành Đa-vít. Nàng ở đó cho đến khi Sa-lô-môn xây xong cung điện, đền thờ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, và tường thành bao quanh Giê-ru-sa-lem.

ko.L: 그리고 솔로몬이 이집트 왕 바로와 사돈을 맺었다. 그리고 그는 바로의 딸을 맞아들여, 자기 집과 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집과 예루살렘 사방의 성벽을 다 짓기까지 그 여자를 다윗 성에 데려다 두었다.
ko.B: 솔로몬은 이집트 왕 바로와 혼인 동맹을 맺었다. 그는 바로의 딸과 결혼하여, 자기 궁전과 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집과 예루살렘을 둘러싼 성벽을 다 지을 때까지 그 여자를 다윗 성에서 살게 했다.
ko.R: 솔로몬은 이집트 왕 바로의 딸과 결혼하여 바로와 동맹을 맺었다. 그는 그 여자를 예루살렘의 가장 오래된 곳인 다윗 성에 데려와 살게 했다. 그 여자는 솔로몬이 자기 왕궁과 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성전과 예루살렘 둘레의 성벽을 다 지을 때까지 거기서 지냈다.

pt.L: E Salomão se tornou genro de Faraó, rei do Egito; e tomou a filha de Faraó e a trouxe para a Cidade de Davi, até acabar de construir a sua casa, e a casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, e o muro ao redor de Jerusalém.
pt.B: Salomão fez um acordo com Faraó, rei do Egito, tornando-se genro dele. Casou-se com a filha de Faraó e a trouxe para morar na Cidade de Davi, até terminar de construir o seu palácio, a casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} e o muro ao redor de Jerusalém.
pt.R: Salomão fez um tratado com Faraó, o rei do Egito, casando-se com a filha dele. Ele a levou para morar na parte mais antiga de Jerusalém, chamada Cidade de Davi. Ela ficou ali até Salomão terminar de construir o seu palácio, o templo {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} e o muro ao redor de toda a cidade de Jerusalém.

decisions.choice: became son-in-law to Pharaoh: a marriage that sealed an alliance
decisions.reason: The verb means to become related by marriage. Kings sealed treaties by marrying into each other's families, and a Pharaoh's daughter given to a king of Israel shows how high Solomon now stood. Pharaoh later gives her the town of Gezer as a wedding gift (9:16). The Pharaoh is not named.

decisions.choice: the city of David: the old fortress of Jerusalem
decisions.reason: This is the stronghold of Zion that David captured and named after himself (2 Samuel 5:7, 9), the oldest part of the city. Pharaoh's daughter later moves out of it into a house Solomon built for her (9:24), because a place where the ark had been was holy (2 Chronicles 8:11).

decisions.choice: his house, the house of Yahweh, the wall: the building works of the next chapters
decisions.reason: The verse names in advance the building told later: the house of Yahweh (chapter 6), Solomon's palace (7:1-12) and the wall of Jerusalem (9:15).

decisions.choice: Pharaoh's daughter: a marriage the book later weighs
decisions.reason: Here the marriage is told without comment. Later the book names Pharaoh's daughter among the many foreign wives who turned Solomon's heart away from Yahweh (11:1-4; compare Deuteronomy 17:17).

decisions.choice: his own palace; the house of the LORD (Balanced); the temple of the LORD (Readable)
decisions.reason: The same Hebrew word "house" is used for the king's palace and for Yahweh's temple. Balanced says "palace" for the king's house and keeps "house" for Yahweh's; Readable says "temple", the word its readers know.

decisions.choice: the oldest part of Jerusalem, called the city of David
decisions.reason: Readable explains what the city of David was (m2), and says what the marriage alliance was for.

decisions.choice: "su casa" (L), "su palacio" (B, R); "la casa del SEÑOR" (L, B), "el templo del SEÑOR" (R)
decisions.reason: The house of the LORD follows the Kings terms note: "la casa del SEÑOR" at Literal and Balanced, "el templo del SEÑOR" at Readable; the king's house is "palacio" where the English says "palace" (r-en-1). "el faraón" keeps the article, as in the Pentateuch terms list.

decisions.choice: sa maison (L), son palais (B, R); la maison du SEIGNEUR (L, B), le temple du SEIGNEUR (R)
decisions.reason: One Hebrew word serves for the king's house and for the LORD's. As the terms note settles for these books, Literal keeps "maison" for both, Balanced says "palais" for the king's and keeps "la maison du SEIGNEUR", and Readable says "le temple du SEIGNEUR".

decisions.choice: Pharaon
decisions.reason: As in the French Pentateuch, "Pharaon" without the article where the English says "Pharaoh" as a name.

decisions.choice: nyumba yake (Literal); ikulu yake (Balanced, Readable); nyumba ya BWANA (Literal, Balanced); hekalu la BWANA (Readable)
decisions.reason: The one Hebrew word "house" is the king's palace and Yahweh's temple. Balanced and Readable say "ikulu" for the palace; Yahweh's house is "nyumba ya BWANA" at Literal and Balanced and "hekalu la BWANA" at Readable, as the terms note settles for these books.

decisions.choice: "nhà của CHÚA" (L, B); "đền thờ của CHÚA" (R)
decisions.reason: The Kings terms note's wording for the house of the LORD at each level, used through these books.

decisions.choice: "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집" (L, B); "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성전" (R)
decisions.reason: As the Kings and Chronicles terms note: the house of the LORD is 집 at Literal and Balanced and 성전 at Readable; where the English Balanced itself says "temple", Balanced says 성전 too.

decisions.choice: fez um acordo com Faraó, tornando-se genro dele
alternatives: fez uma aliança de casamento com Faraó
decisions.reason: The marriage sealed an alliance (m1). Portuguese "aliança de casamento" is first of all the wedding ring, so Balanced names the agreement ("acordo") and the marriage tie ("genro") separately. "Faraó" without the article, as the English says "Pharaoh" here, following the Old Testament terms; "a Cidade de Davi" with a capital, as 2 Samuel 5:7 in Portuguese.

source.text: רַ֣ק הָעָ֔ם מְזַבְּחִ֖ים בַּבָּמ֑וֹת כִּ֠י לֹא־נִבְנָ֥ה בַ֨יִת֙ לְשֵׁ֣ם יְהוָ֔ה עַ֖ד הַיָּמִ֥ים הָהֵֽם׃פ

records.literal_gloss: Only the people [were] sacrificing at the high places, because not had been built a house for [the] name of Yahweh until those days.

en.L: Only, the people were sacrificing at the high places, because a house for the name of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had not been built until those days.
en.B: The people, however, were still offering sacrifices at the high places, because no house had yet been built for the name of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} in those days.
en.R: But in those days the people were still offering sacrifices at the hilltop shrines. This was because no temple had been built yet as the place where {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} would be worshiped.

es.L: Solo que el pueblo sacrificaba en los lugares altos, porque no se había edificado casa al nombre {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} hasta aquellos días.
es.B: Sin embargo, el pueblo todavía ofrecía sacrificios en los lugares altos, porque en aquellos días aún no se había edificado una casa para el nombre {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.R: Pero en aquellos días el pueblo todavía ofrecía sacrificios en los santuarios sobre las colinas. Esto era porque todavía no se había construido un templo como el lugar donde se adoraría {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Seulement, le peuple sacrifiait sur les hauts lieux, car une maison pour le nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} n’avait pas été bâtie jusqu’à ces jours-là.
fr.B: Le peuple, cependant, offrait encore ses sacrifices sur les hauts lieux, car en ce temps-là aucune maison n’avait encore été bâtie pour le nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Mais à cette époque, le peuple offrait encore des sacrifices dans les sanctuaires sur les collines. En effet, on n’avait pas encore construit de temple où l’on adorerait {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Ila watu walikuwa wakitoa dhabihu mahali pa juu, kwa sababu nyumba kwa ajili ya jina la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ilikuwa haijajengwa mpaka siku zile.
sw.B: Hata hivyo watu walikuwa bado wakitoa dhabihu mahali pa juu, kwa sababu siku zile hapakuwa bado na nyumba iliyojengwa kwa ajili ya jina la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Lakini siku zile watu walikuwa bado wakitoa dhabihu katika patakatifu pa kilimani. Hii ilikuwa kwa sababu hapakuwa bado na hekalu lililojengwa kuwa mahali pa kumwabudu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

vi.L: Chỉ có điều dân chúng [vẫn] dâng sinh tế tại các nơi cao, vì cho đến những ngày ấy chưa có nhà nào được xây cho danh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.B: Tuy nhiên, dân chúng vẫn còn dâng sinh tế tại các nơi cao, vì vào thời ấy chưa có nhà nào được xây cho danh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.R: Nhưng thời ấy dân chúng vẫn còn dâng sinh tế tại các nơi thờ phượng trên đồi cao. Đó là vì chưa có đền thờ nào được xây làm nơi thờ phượng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.

ko.L: 다만 백성은 산당에서 제사를 드리고 있었다. 그때까지 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 이름을 위한 집이 지어지지 않았기 때문이다.
ko.B: 그러나 백성은 여전히 산당에서 제사를 드리고 있었다. 그때까지 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 이름을 위한 집이 아직 지어지지 않았기 때문이다.
ko.R: 그러나 그 무렵 백성은 여전히 산꼭대기 제단에서 제사를 드렸다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 예배할 성전이 아직 지어지지 않았기 때문이다.

pt.L: Só que o povo estava sacrificando nos altos, porque não tinha sido construída uma casa para o nome {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} até aqueles dias.
pt.B: O povo, porém, ainda oferecia sacrifícios nos altos, porque naqueles dias ainda não se tinha construído uma casa para o nome {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}.
pt.R: Mas naquele tempo o povo ainda oferecia sacrifícios nos santuários no alto dos morros. É que ainda não tinha sido construído um templo como o lugar onde {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} seria adorado.

decisions.choice: the high places: local shrines, often on raised ground
decisions.reason: A high place was a place of worship with an altar, usually on a hill or a raised platform. Israelites used them to worship Yahweh as well as other gods. Later kings are judged by whether they removed them (15:14; 22:44; 2 Kings 18:4).

decisions.choice: a house for the name of Yahweh: the one place Yahweh would choose
decisions.reason: Deuteronomy looks ahead to a single place where Yahweh would make his name live, and where Israel would bring its offerings (Deuteronomy 12:5, 11, 13-14). Until that house was built, the narrator explains, worship at the high places went on. His "only" marks this as a shortcoming, even if an understandable one.

decisions.choice: only: a qualification of what came before
decisions.reason: The word limits what has just been said: Solomon's reign was well established (2:46), but worship was not yet as it should be. The same word opens the qualification of Solomon himself in verse 3.

decisions.choice: high places (Literal, Balanced); hilltop shrines (Readable)
decisions.reason: The wording kept for this word in these books.

decisions.choice: no temple ... as the place where the LORD would be worshiped
decisions.reason: Readable says "temple" for the house and explains what "for the name of the LORD" meant (m2).

decisions.choice: "los lugares altos" (L, B); "los santuarios sobre las colinas" (R)
decisions.reason: The high places follow the Kings terms note for Spanish, one wording per level through the four books. The English keeps "high places" at Balanced (r-en-1); Spanish Balanced says what they were, as the terms note sets.

decisions.choice: les hauts lieux (L, B); les sanctuaires sur les collines (R)
decisions.reason: The wording of the terms note for *bamot* through Kings and Chronicles.

decisions.choice: mahali pa juu (Literal, Balanced); patakatifu pa kilimani (Readable)
decisions.reason: The high places in the wording settled for Swahili in the Samuel and Kings notes; used through this block.

decisions.choice: "các nơi cao" (L, B); "các nơi thờ phượng trên đồi cao" (R)
decisions.reason: The Kings terms note's words for the high places, local shrines often on raised ground (meaning decision); kept through these books.

decisions.choice: "산당" (L, B); "산꼭대기 제단" (R)
decisions.reason: As the Kings and Chronicles terms note for *bamot*, through all four books.

decisions.choice: os altos (L, B); os santuários no alto dos morros (R)
decisions.reason: For the whole book: "os altos" is the traditional Portuguese name for these shrines (m1) and the one kept through Kings, where later kings are judged by whether they removed them; 1 Samuel 9 in Portuguese says "o lugar alto" for one shrine. Readable explains it, as the English "hilltop shrines" does, in the words of 1 Samuel 9:12 in Portuguese ("o santuário do alto do morro").

source.text: וַיֶּאֱהַ֤ב שְׁלֹמֹה֙ אֶת־יְהוָ֔ה לָלֶ֕כֶת בְּחֻקּ֖וֹת דָּוִ֣ד אָבִ֑יו רַ֚ק בַּבָּמ֔וֹת ה֥וּא מְזַבֵּ֖חַ וּמַקְטִֽיר׃

records.literal_gloss: And loved Solomon Yahweh, walking in [the] statutes of David his father; only at the high places he [was] sacrificing and burning [offerings].

en.L: And Solomon loved {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, walking in the statutes of David his father; only, he was sacrificing and burning [offerings] at the high places.
en.B: Solomon loved {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and lived by the statutes of his father David, except that he too offered sacrifices and burned offerings at the high places.
en.R: Solomon loved {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. He followed the laws his father David had given him. But he also offered sacrifices and burned offerings at the hilltop shrines.

es.L: Y amó Salomón {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, andando en los estatutos de David su padre; solo que en los lugares altos sacrificaba y quemaba [ofrendas].
es.B: Salomón amaba {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} y vivía según los estatutos de su padre David, solo que también ofrecía sacrificios y quemaba ofrendas en los lugares altos.
es.R: Salomón amaba {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}. Seguía las leyes que su padre David le había dado. Pero también ofrecía sacrificios y quemaba ofrendas en los santuarios sobre las colinas.

fr.L: Et Salomon aimait {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, marchant selon les prescriptions de David son père ; seulement, il sacrifiait et brûlait [des offrandes] sur les hauts lieux.
fr.B: Salomon aimait {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} et suivait les prescriptions de son père David ; seulement, lui aussi offrait des sacrifices et brûlait des offrandes sur les hauts lieux.
fr.R: Salomon aimait {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. Il suivait les lois que son père David lui avait données. Mais il offrait lui aussi des sacrifices et brûlait des offrandes dans les sanctuaires sur les collines.

sw.L: Sulemani akampenda {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, akienda katika kanuni za Daudi baba yake; ila alikuwa akitoa dhabihu na kufukiza [sadaka] mahali pa juu.
sw.B: Sulemani alimpenda {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, akaishi kwa kufuata kanuni za baba yake Daudi; ila yeye pia alitoa dhabihu na kufukiza sadaka mahali pa juu.
sw.R: Sulemani alimpenda {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Alifuata sheria ambazo baba yake Daudi alikuwa amempa. Lakini yeye pia alitoa dhabihu na kuteketeza sadaka katika patakatifu pa kilimani.

vi.L: Sa-lô-môn yêu mến {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, bước đi theo các luật lệ của Đa-vít cha mình; chỉ có điều vua [vẫn] dâng sinh tế và đốt [lễ vật] tại các nơi cao.
vi.B: Sa-lô-môn yêu mến {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và sống theo các luật lệ của Đa-vít cha mình, chỉ trừ một điều là vua cũng dâng sinh tế và đốt lễ vật tại các nơi cao.
vi.R: Sa-lô-môn yêu mến {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Vua làm theo những luật lệ mà Đa-vít cha mình đã truyền dạy. Nhưng vua cũng dâng sinh tế và đốt lễ vật tại các nơi thờ phượng trên đồi cao.

ko.L: 그리고 솔로몬은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 사랑하여 자기 아버지 다윗의 규례대로 걸었다. 다만 그는 산당에서 제사를 드리고 [제물을] 태웠다.
ko.B: 솔로몬은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 사랑하여 아버지 다윗의 규례를 따라 살았다. 다만 그도 산당에서 제사를 드리고 제물을 태워 바쳤다.
ko.R: 솔로몬은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 사랑했다. 그는 아버지 다윗이 가르쳐 준 법대로 살았다. 그러나 그도 산꼭대기 제단에서 제사를 드리고 제물을 태워 바쳤다.

pt.L: E Salomão amou {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, andando nos estatutos de Davi, seu pai; só que nos altos ele sacrificava e queimava [ofertas].
pt.B: Salomão amava {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} e vivia segundo os estatutos do seu pai Davi; só que ele também oferecia sacrifícios e queimava ofertas nos altos.
pt.R: Salomão amava {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}. Ele seguia as leis que o seu pai Davi lhe tinha dado. Mas ele também oferecia sacrifícios e queimava ofertas nos santuários no alto dos morros.

decisions.choice: the statutes of David his father: the way of life David charged him to keep
decisions.reason: These are not laws David made, but the way he lived and the charge he gave Solomon to keep Yahweh's statutes and commandments as the law of Moses writes them (2:3). Walking in them means living by them.

decisions.choice: burning offerings: making sacrifices go up in smoke
decisions.reason: The verb means to make something go up in smoke. It can mean burning incense, but in Kings it often means burning the fat and parts of sacrifices on the altar; here it stands beside "sacrificing" as the second half of one act of worship.

decisions.choice: Solomon loved Yahweh; only ...: praise with a reservation
decisions.reason: Solomon's love for Yahweh is stated plainly, as Deuteronomy asks of every Israelite (Deuteronomy 6:5). The "only" that follows repeats the reservation of verse 2. The book later says that Solomon "loved many foreign women" (11:1), and the love that begins here is divided.

decisions.choice: burning [offerings] (Literal); burned offerings (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: The verb has no object in Hebrew; English needs one. See m2.

decisions.choice: the laws his father David had given him
decisions.reason: Readable says "laws", the word it uses for statutes, and explains that they were the charge David gave Solomon (m1).

source.text: וַיֵּ֨לֶךְ הַמֶּ֤לֶךְ גִּבְעֹ֨נָה֙ לִזְבֹּ֣חַ שָׁ֔ם כִּ֥י הִ֖יא הַבָּמָ֣ה הַגְּדוֹלָ֑ה אֶ֤לֶף עֹלוֹת֙ יַעֲלֶ֣ה שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה עַ֖ל הַמִּזְבֵּ֥חַ הַהֽוּא׃

records.literal_gloss: And went the king to Gibeon to sacrifice there, because it [was] the great high place; a thousand burnt offerings offered up Solomon on that altar.

en.L: And the king went to Gibeon to sacrifice there, for that [was] the great high place; Solomon offered up a thousand burnt offerings on that altar.
en.B: The king went to Gibeon to sacrifice there, because it was the most important high place. On that altar Solomon offered up a thousand burnt offerings.
en.R: King Solomon went to the town of Gibeon to offer sacrifices, because it had the most important hilltop shrine. He offered a thousand burnt offerings on the altar there.

es.L: Y fue el rey a Gabaón a sacrificar allí, porque aquel [era] el lugar alto grande; mil holocaustos ofreció Salomón sobre aquel altar.
es.B: El rey fue a Gabaón a ofrecer sacrificios allí, porque ese era el santuario más importante. Salomón ofreció mil holocaustos sobre aquel altar.
es.R: El rey Salomón fue al pueblo de Gabaón a ofrecer sacrificios, porque allí estaba el santuario más importante sobre las colinas. Ofreció mil holocaustos en el altar de ese lugar.

fr.L: Et le roi alla à Gabaon pour y sacrifier, car c’[était] le grand haut lieu ; Salomon offrit mille holocaustes sur cet autel.
fr.B: Le roi se rendit à Gabaon pour y offrir des sacrifices, car c’était le haut lieu le plus important. Salomon offrit mille holocaustes sur cet autel.
fr.R: Le roi Salomon est allé dans la ville de Gabaon pour offrir des sacrifices, parce que c’était là que se trouvait le sanctuaire le plus important. Il a offert mille holocaustes sur l’autel de cet endroit.

sw.L: Mfalme akaenda Gibeoni kutoa dhabihu huko, kwa maana hapo [palikuwa] mahali pa juu palipo pakuu; Sulemani akatoa sadaka elfu moja za kuteketezwa juu ya madhabahu ile.
sw.B: Mfalme alikwenda Gibeoni kutoa dhabihu huko, kwa sababu hapo palikuwa mahali pa juu palipokuwa muhimu kuliko pote. Juu ya madhabahu ile Sulemani alitoa sadaka elfu moja za kuteketezwa.
sw.R: Mfalme Sulemani alikwenda mji wa Gibeoni kutoa dhabihu, kwa sababu huko ndiko kulikokuwa na patakatifu pa kilimani palipokuwa muhimu kuliko pote. Akatoa sadaka elfu moja za kuteketezwa juu ya madhabahu ya huko.

vi.L: Vua đi đến Ga-ba-ôn để dâng sinh tế tại đó, vì đó [là] nơi cao lớn nhất; Sa-lô-môn dâng một ngàn của lễ thiêu trên bàn thờ ấy.
vi.B: Vua đi đến Ga-ba-ôn để dâng sinh tế, vì đó là nơi cao quan trọng nhất. Sa-lô-môn dâng một ngàn của lễ thiêu trên bàn thờ ấy.
vi.R: Vua Sa-lô-môn đi đến thành Ga-ba-ôn để dâng sinh tế, vì ở đó có nơi thờ phượng trên đồi cao quan trọng nhất. Vua dâng một ngàn của lễ thiêu trên bàn thờ tại đó.

ko.L: 그리고 왕이 거기서 제사를 드리려고 기브온으로 갔다. 그곳이 큰 산당이었기 때문이다. 솔로몬은 그 제단 위에 번제물 천 마리를 바쳤다.
ko.B: 왕은 제사를 드리러 기브온으로 갔다. 그곳이 가장 중요한 산당이었기 때문이다. 솔로몬은 그 제단에서 번제물 천 마리를 바쳤다.
ko.R: 솔로몬 왕은 제사를 드리러 기브온 성읍으로 갔다. 그곳에 가장 중요한 산꼭대기 제단이 있었기 때문이다. 그는 거기 제단에서 번제물 천 마리를 바쳤다.

pt.L: E o rei foi a Gibeom para sacrificar ali, porque aquele [era] o grande alto; mil holocaustos Salomão ofereceu sobre aquele altar.
pt.B: O rei foi a Gibeom para oferecer sacrifícios ali, porque aquele era o alto mais importante. Naquele altar Salomão ofereceu mil holocaustos.
pt.R: O rei Salomão foi à cidade de Gibeom para oferecer sacrifícios, porque ali ficava o mais importante dos santuários no alto dos morros. Ele ofereceu mil holocaustos no altar daquele lugar.

decisions.choice: the great high place: the shrine where the tabernacle then stood
decisions.reason: Gibeon lay a few miles northwest of Jerusalem. Chronicles explains why it was the great high place: the tent of meeting that Moses made, and the bronze altar of the wilderness, were there (1 Chronicles 16:39; 21:29; 2 Chronicles 1:3-6), while the ark was in Jerusalem (2 Samuel 6:17).

decisions.choice: the visit to Gibeon told again in 2 Chronicles 1
decisions.reason: 2 Chronicles 1:2-13 tells this visit and the dream that follows. It adds that all the assembly went with Solomon to the tent of meeting, and that the altar was the bronze altar Bezalel made (Exodus 38:1-2). It leaves out the remark about the high places (verses 2-3) and the story of the two women.

decisions.choice: a thousand burnt offerings: offered over the time of his visit
decisions.reason: The verb form can describe what Solomon did repeatedly or over a period. A thousand whole offerings show a king's generous devotion; they would have been burned over several days.

decisions.choice: high place (Literal, Balanced); hilltop shrine (Readable)
decisions.reason: As in verse 2.

decisions.choice: the most important
decisions.reason: "Great" here means chief in importance, not size, so Balanced and Readable say "most important".

decisions.choice: Gibeom
decisions.reason: For the whole book: the town's name as Joshua 9-10 and 2 Samuel 2:12-16 write it in Portuguese.

source.text: בְּגִבְע֗וֹן נִרְאָ֧ה יְהֹוָ֛ה אֶל־שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה בַּחֲל֣וֹם הַלָּ֑יְלָה וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֱלֹהִ֔ים שְׁאַ֖ל מָ֥ה אֶתֶּן־לָֽךְ׃

records.literal_gloss: In Gibeon appeared Yahweh to Solomon in a dream of the night, and said God, Ask what I shall give to you.

en.L: At Gibeon {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} appeared to Solomon in a dream of the night, and God said, "Ask what I shall give you."
en.B: At Gibeon {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} appeared to Solomon in a dream at night. God said, "Ask for whatever you want {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} to give you."
en.R: While Solomon was at Gibeon, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} appeared to him in a dream one night. God said to him, "Ask {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} for anything you want, and I will give it to you."

es.L: En Gabaón se apareció {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} a Salomón en un sueño de noche, y dijo Dios: «Pide lo que quieras que yo te dé».
es.B: En Gabaón {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} se le apareció a Salomón en un sueño durante la noche. Dios le dijo: «Pídeme lo que quieras que te dé».
es.R: Mientras Salomón estaba en Gabaón, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} se le apareció en un sueño una noche. Dios le dijo: «Pídeme lo que quieras, y yo te lo daré».

fr.L: À Gabaon, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} apparut à Salomon dans un rêve de la nuit, et Dieu dit : « Demande ce que je dois te donner. »
fr.B: À Gabaon, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} apparut en rêve à Salomon pendant la nuit. Dieu lui dit : « Demande ce que tu veux que je te donne. »
fr.R: Pendant que Salomon était à Gabaon, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} lui est apparu dans un rêve, une nuit. Dieu lui a dit : « Demande-{{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} tout ce que tu veux, et je te le donnerai. »

sw.L: Huko Gibeoni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akamtokea Sulemani katika ndoto ya usiku, Mungu akasema, "Omba nikupe nini."
sw.B: Huko Gibeoni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alimtokea Sulemani katika ndoto usiku. Mungu akasema, "Omba lolote unalotaka nikupe."
sw.R: Sulemani alipokuwa Gibeoni, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alimtokea katika ndoto usiku mmoja. Mungu akamwambia, "Niombe chochote unachotaka, nami nitakupa."

vi.L: Tại Ga-ba-ôn, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} hiện ra với Sa-lô-môn trong một giấc mơ ban đêm, và Đức Chúa Trời phán: "Hãy xin điều Ta sẽ ban cho ngươi."
vi.B: Tại Ga-ba-ôn, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} hiện ra với Sa-lô-môn trong giấc mơ ban đêm. Đức Chúa Trời phán: "Con muốn Ta ban cho con điều gì, hãy xin đi."
vi.R: Khi Sa-lô-môn ở Ga-ba-ôn, một đêm kia {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} hiện ra với vua trong giấc mơ. Đức Chúa Trời phán với vua: "Con muốn gì, hãy xin Ta, Ta sẽ ban cho con."

ko.L: 기브온에서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 밤에 꿈에 솔로몬에게 나타나셨다. 그리고 하나님께서 말씀하셨다. "내가 네게 무엇을 줄지 구하여라."
ko.B: 기브온에서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 밤에 솔로몬의 꿈에 나타나셨다. 하나님께서 말씀하셨다. "내가 네게 무엇을 주면 좋겠느냐? 구하여라."
ko.R: 솔로몬이 기브온에 있을 때, 어느 날 밤 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그의 꿈에 나타나셨다. 하나님께서 그에게 말씀하셨다. "무엇이든 원하는 것을 구하여라. 내가 너에게 주겠다."

pt.L: Em Gibeom {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} apareceu a Salomão num sonho da noite, e Deus disse: "Pede o que queres que eu te dê."
pt.B: Em Gibeom {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} apareceu a Salomão num sonho, de noite. Deus disse: "Pede-{{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} o que queres que eu te dê."
pt.R: Enquanto Salomão estava em Gibeom, {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} apareceu a ele num sonho, certa noite. Deus disse a ele: "Pede-{{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} o que quiseres, e eu te darei."

decisions.choice: appeared in a dream of the night: a revelation in sleep
decisions.reason: Yahweh made himself known in dreams to Abimelech, Jacob and others (Genesis 20:3; 28:12-13; Numbers 12:6). The night follows Solomon's sacrifices. Verse 15 says that he woke and knew it had been a dream, but what Yahweh promised in it was real.

decisions.choice: Ask what I shall give you: an open offer
decisions.reason: God does not limit what Solomon may ask. The offer is a test of what Solomon most wants; his answer is what pleases God (verse 10). 2 Chronicles 1:7 gives the same words.

decisions.choice: Yahweh ... God: one speaker
decisions.reason: The narrator names Yahweh as the one who appeared and then says "God said". The two names refer to the same speaker, as often in these books.

decisions.choice: Ask {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} for anything you want, and I will give it to you.
decisions.reason: Readable spells out the offer as a promise, which is what the question "what shall I give you" means here.

decisions.choice: "Pídeme" with no deity_pronoun span
decisions.reason: The English "Me" for God (r-en-1) is a clitic joined to the verb in Spanish, "Pídeme", which the Samuel notes leave without a span.

decisions.choice: God says "Ta" and calls Solomon "ngươi" (L), "con" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Genesis note's forms for God speaking to a person, used for God and David in 2 Samuel 7.

decisions.choice: God speaks 해라체 with "나" and "너"; no deity_pronoun span in Korean
decisions.reason: As the Korean style guide: God speaks 해라체, and Korean has no capital letters, so the respect the English deity pronoun shows is carried by the honorific and 그분.

decisions.choice: Pede o que queres que eu te dê (L, B); Pede-me o que quiseres, e eu te darei (R)
decisions.reason: God speaks to Solomon with "tu" (style section 4, as he speaks to David's line in 2 Samuel 7 in Portuguese), here and in verses 11-14; Solomon answers him with "tu" too. Literal and Balanced turn the open question (m2) into the natural Portuguese "o que queres que eu te dê"; Readable makes it a promise, as the English does.

source.text: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר שְׁלֹמֹ֗ה אַתָּ֨ה עָשִׂ֜יתָ עִם־עַבְדְּךָ֙ דָוִ֣ד אָבִי֮ חֶ֣סֶד גָּדוֹל֒ כַּאֲשֶׁר֩ הָלַ֨ךְ לְפָנֶ֜יךָ בֶּאֱמֶ֧ת וּבִצְדָקָ֛ה וּבְיִשְׁרַ֥ת לֵבָ֖ב עִמָּ֑ךְ וַתִּשְׁמָר־ל֗וֹ אֶת־הַחֶ֤סֶד הַגָּדוֹל֙ הַזֶּ֔ה וַתִּתֶּן־ל֥וֹ בֵ֛ן יֹשֵׁ֥ב עַל־כִּסְא֖וֹ כַּיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And said Solomon, You have done with your servant David my father great steadfast love, as he walked before you in faithfulness and in righteousness and in uprightness of heart with you; and you have kept for him this great steadfast love and given to him a son sitting on his throne as this day.

en.L: And Solomon said, "You have shown great steadfast love to {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} slave David my father, as he walked before {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} in faithfulness and in righteousness and in uprightness of heart toward {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}; and {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have kept for him this great steadfast love and have given him a son sitting on his throne, as [it is] this day.
en.B: Solomon answered, "You showed great faithful love to {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant, my father David, because he lived his life before {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} with faithfulness and righteousness and an upright heart. And {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have kept this great faithful love for him by giving him a son to sit on his throne, as he does today.
en.R: Solomon answered, "You were very kind and faithful to my father David, {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant. He lived to please {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}. He was faithful and righteous, and his heart was honest toward {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}. And {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have kept on showing him this great faithful love. You have given him a son who sits on his throne today.

es.L: Y dijo Salomón: «Tú has hecho gran amor leal con {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} siervo David mi padre, según anduvo delante de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} en verdad y en justicia y con rectitud de corazón para contigo; y le has guardado este gran amor leal, y le has dado un hijo que se siente en su trono, como [sucede] este día.
es.B: Salomón respondió: «Tú mostraste gran amor fiel a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} siervo, mi padre David, porque él vivió delante de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} con fidelidad, con justicia y con un corazón recto. Y le has mantenido este gran amor fiel dándole un hijo que se sienta en su trono, como sucede hoy.
es.R: Salomón respondió: «Tú fuiste muy bondadoso y fiel con mi padre David, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} siervo. Él vivió para agradarte. Fue fiel y justo, y su corazón fue sincero contigo. Y {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} has seguido mostrándole este gran amor fiel. Le has dado un hijo que hoy se sienta en su trono.

fr.L: Et Salomon dit : « Tu as montré un grand amour loyal à {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur David mon père, selon qu’il a marché devant {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} dans la fidélité, et dans la justice, et dans la droiture de cœur envers {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} ; et {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} lui as gardé ce grand amour loyal et {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} lui as donné un fils assis sur son trône, comme [c’est] aujourd’hui.
fr.B: Salomon répondit : « Tu as montré un grand amour fidèle à {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur, mon père David, parce qu’il a vécu devant {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} avec fidélité, avec justice et d’un cœur droit. Et {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} lui as gardé ce grand amour fidèle en lui donnant un fils pour s’asseoir sur son trône, comme c’est le cas aujourd’hui.
fr.R: Salomon a répondu : « Tu as été très bon et fidèle envers mon père David, {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur. Il a vécu pour {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} plaire. Il était fidèle et juste, et son cœur était honnête envers {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}. Et {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as continué à lui montrer ce grand amour fidèle. Tu lui as donné un fils qui est assis sur son trône aujourd’hui.

sw.L: Sulemani akasema, "Wewe umemtendea mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} Daudi baba yangu upendo usiokoma mkuu, kama alivyokwenda mbele {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} kwa uaminifu na kwa haki na kwa unyofu wa moyo pamoja {{deity_pronoun:nawe|Nawe}}; nawe umemhifadhia upendo huu usiokoma mkuu, ukampa mwana anayeketi juu ya kiti chake cha enzi, kama [ilivyo] siku hii ya leo.
sw.B: Sulemani akajibu, "Ulimwonyesha mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}, baba yangu Daudi, fadhili kuu, kwa sababu aliishi mbele {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} kwa uaminifu na haki na kwa moyo mnyofu. Nawe umeendelea kumwonyesha fadhili hizi kuu kwa kumpa mwana wa kuketi juu ya kiti chake cha enzi, kama ilivyo leo.
sw.R: Sulemani akajibu, "Ulikuwa mwema na mwaminifu sana kwa baba yangu Daudi, mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}. Aliishi kwa kukupendeza. Alikuwa mwaminifu na mwenye haki, na moyo wake ulikuwa mnyofu kwako. Nawe umeendelea kumwonyesha fadhili hizi kuu. Umempa mwana anayeketi juu ya kiti chake cha enzi leo.

vi.L: Sa-lô-môn thưa: "Ngài đã tỏ tình yêu thương thành tín lớn lao với đầy tớ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là Đa-vít cha con, vì người đã bước đi trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} trong sự thành tín, trong sự công chính, và với tấm lòng ngay thẳng đối với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã giữ cho người tình yêu thương thành tín lớn lao này, và đã ban cho người một con trai ngồi trên ngai người, như [ngày] hôm nay.
vi.B: Sa-lô-môn thưa: "Ngài đã tỏ tình yêu thương thành tín lớn lao với đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là Đa-vít cha con, vì người đã sống trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} với lòng thành tín, công chính và ngay thẳng. Ngài còn giữ tình yêu thương thành tín lớn lao ấy cho người khi ban cho người một con trai ngồi trên ngai người như ngày nay.
vi.R: Sa-lô-môn thưa: "Ngài đã rất nhân từ và thành tín với Đa-vít cha con, đầy tớ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Cha con đã sống đẹp lòng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Người trung tín, công chính, và có tấm lòng ngay thẳng đối với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Ngài vẫn tiếp tục tỏ tình thương không hề thay đổi lớn lao ấy với người. Ngài đã ban cho người một con trai đang ngồi trên ngai người hôm nay.

ko.L: 그리고 솔로몬이 말했다. "주님께서는 주님의 종, 제 아버지 다윗이 진실함과 의로움과 주님을 향한 정직한 마음으로 주님 앞에서 걸었으므로, 그에게 큰 한결같은 사랑을 베푸셨습니다. 그리고 주님께서는 그를 위하여 이 큰 한결같은 사랑을 지키셔서, 오늘처럼 그의 왕좌에 앉을 아들을 그에게 주셨습니다.
ko.B: 솔로몬이 대답했다. "주님께서는 주님의 종인 제 아버지 다윗에게 크나큰 인애를 베푸셨습니다. 그가 신실함과 의로움과 정직한 마음으로 주님 앞에서 살았기 때문입니다. 주님께서는 그에게 이 크나큰 인애를 계속 베푸셔서, 오늘 이렇게 그의 왕좌에 앉을 아들을 그에게 주셨습니다.
ko.R: 솔로몬이 대답했다. "주님께서는 주님의 종인 제 아버지 다윗에게 참으로 큰 인애를 베푸셨습니다. 그는 주님을 기쁘시게 하며 살았습니다. 그는 신실하고 의로웠으며 주님 앞에서 마음이 정직했습니다. 그리고 주님께서는 그에게 이 큰 인애를 계속 베푸셨습니다. 오늘 그의 왕좌에 앉아 있는 아들을 그에게 주셨습니다.

pt.L: E Salomão disse: "Tu mostraste grande amor leal ao {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} escravo Davi, meu pai, conforme ele andou diante de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} em fidelidade, e em justiça, e em retidão de coração para {{deity_pronoun:contigo|Contigo}}; e {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} guardaste para ele este grande amor leal e lhe deste um filho que se assenta no seu trono, como [é] neste dia.
pt.B: Salomão respondeu: "Tu mostraste grande amor leal ao {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} servo, meu pai Davi, porque ele viveu diante de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} com fidelidade, justiça e um coração reto. E {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} conservaste para ele este grande amor leal, dando-lhe um filho para se sentar no seu trono, como acontece hoje.
pt.R: Salomão respondeu: "Tu foste muito bondoso e fiel com o meu pai Davi, o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} servo. Ele viveu para {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} agradar. Ele era fiel e justo, e o seu coração era sincero para {{deity_pronoun:contigo|Contigo}}. E {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} continuaste a mostrar a ele este grande amor leal. Tu lhe deste um filho que hoje se senta no trono dele.

decisions.choice: steadfast love: loyal kindness that keeps faith
decisions.reason: The word names love that is loyal to a bond, kept even when it costs. Yahweh had promised David a son on his throne and a love that would not be taken away (2 Samuel 7:12-15). Solomon sees that promise kept in himself.

decisions.choice: as he walked before you: in keeping with David's life
decisions.reason: The words can mean "because" or "in keeping with". Solomon ties Yahweh's love to David's faithful life, as 2:4 and 9:4 do, without saying David earned it.

decisions.choice: faithfulness, righteousness, uprightness of heart: a whole life lived honestly toward God
decisions.reason: The three words describe how David lived: true to his word, doing what is right, and with an honest heart. To walk before someone is to live in his sight and serve him.

decisions.choice: your servant David: David as Yahweh's servant
decisions.reason: The word is the one used for a slave, a person who belongs to a master. As a title for David it is an honor (2 Samuel 7:5; 1 Kings 11:13).

decisions.choice: steadfast love (Literal); faithful love (Balanced, Readable); your slave (Literal); your servant (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: The wording kept for these words in these books. Readable also says "kind and faithful" the first time, to show what the love was.

decisions.choice: He lived to please you.
decisions.reason: Readable breaks the long sentence into short ones and says what "walked before you" means.

decisions.choice: "tu siervo David" at every level
decisions.reason: The English Literal says "slave" for God's servant here (r-en-1); the Samuel notes for Spanish keep "siervo" at every level for David as God's servant, Literal included, so Spanish does not follow the English Literal.

decisions.choice: deity_pronoun spans on "tú", "tu", "ti"
decisions.reason: Solomon's words to God carry the deity_pronoun span on every written pronoun and possessive for God, as the Spanish of 2 Samuel 7 does; clitics joined to verbs ("agradarte") and "contigo" stay plain.

decisions.choice: ton serviteur David (every level)
decisions.reason: David as God's servant is "serviteur" at every level, Literal included, as the French Samuel settles for "my servant David", where the English Literal says "slave".

decisions.choice: mtumishi wako
decisions.reason: A named servant of God (David) is "mtumishi" at every level, Literal included, as the Swahili Psalms and Samuel settle; the English Literal's "slave" has no Swahili counterpart here.

decisions.choice: Solomon prays with "Ngài" and "con"; "đầy tớ của Ngài" (L), "đầy tớ Ngài" (B, R) for David
decisions.reason: The Genesis note's prayer forms; "my servant David" follows the Vietnamese 2 Samuel 7, slave at Literal and servant at Balanced and Readable, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "tình yêu thương thành tín" (L, B); "tình thương không hề thay đổi" (R)
decisions.reason: God's *ḥesed* takes the Psalms note's form at each level; "lòng nhân từ" is kept for kindness between people.

decisions.choice: Solomon prays in 합쇼체 with "주님", calling himself "주님의 종" or "저"
decisions.reason: As the Samuel note for David's prayers and the Korean style guide for prayer.

decisions.choice: "한결같은 사랑" (L); "인애" (B, R) for *ḥesed*
decisions.reason: As the Samuel terms note: one wording for *ḥesed* through these books, Literal and the others apart.

decisions.choice: amor leal (every level); o teu escravo (L), o teu servo (B, R); tu
decisions.reason: Yahweh's steadfast love (m1) is "amor leal" at every level, the Old Testament wording for God's hesed (2 Samuel 7:15 in Portuguese); Readable adds "bondoso e fiel" the first time, as the English adds "kind and faithful". Solomon prays with "tu" (verses 6-9), every pronoun for God under the deity_pronoun span; a "Tu" opening a sentence is written plainly. "Escravo" at Literal follows the English "slave" for David as Yahweh's servant (m4).

source.text: וְעַתָּה֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֔י אַתָּה֙ הִמְלַ֣כְתָּ אֶֽת־עַבְדְּךָ֔ תַּ֖חַת דָּוִ֣ד אָבִ֑י וְאָֽנֹכִי֙ נַ֣עַר קָטֹ֔ן לֹ֥א אֵדַ֖ע צֵ֥את וָבֹֽא׃

records.literal_gloss: And now, Yahweh my God, you have made king your servant in place of David my father; and I [am] a little boy; not I know [how] to go out and to come in.

en.L: And now, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} my God, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have made {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant king in place of David my father, but I [am] a little boy; I do not know [how] to go out or to come in.
en.B: Now, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} my God, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have made {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant king in place of my father David. But I am only a little boy; I do not know how to go out and come in as a leader.
en.R: Now, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} my God, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have made me, {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant, king in place of my father David. But I am like a small child. I do not know how to lead.

es.L: Y ahora, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}} Dios mío, {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} has hecho rey a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} siervo en lugar de David mi padre; y yo [soy] un niño pequeño; no sé [cómo] salir ni entrar.
es.B: Ahora, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}} Dios mío, {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} has hecho rey a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} siervo en lugar de mi padre David. Pero yo no soy más que un niño pequeño; no sé cómo salir y entrar como jefe.
es.R: Ahora, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}} mi Dios, {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} me has hecho rey a mí, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} siervo, en lugar de mi padre David. Pero yo soy como un niño pequeño. No sé cómo gobernar.

fr.L: Et maintenant, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} mon Dieu, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as fait régner {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur à la place de David mon père ; et moi, [je suis] un petit garçon ; je ne sais pas sortir et entrer.
fr.B: Maintenant, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} mon Dieu, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as fait de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur le roi à la place de mon père David. Mais je ne suis qu’un petit garçon ; je ne sais pas comment sortir et entrer pour conduire le peuple.
fr.R: Maintenant, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} mon Dieu, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} m’as fait roi, moi, {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur, à la place de mon père David. Mais je suis comme un petit enfant. Je ne sais pas comment diriger.

sw.L: Na sasa, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wangu, {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} umemtawaza mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} badala ya Daudi baba yangu; nami [ni] mtoto mdogo; sijui [jinsi ya] kutoka wala kuingia.
sw.B: Sasa, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wangu, umemfanya mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} kuwa mfalme mahali pa baba yangu Daudi. Lakini mimi ni mtoto mdogo tu; sijui jinsi ya kutoka na kuingia kama kiongozi.
sw.R: Sasa, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wangu, umenifanya mimi, mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}, kuwa mfalme mahali pa baba yangu Daudi. Lakini mimi ni kama mtoto mdogo. Sijui jinsi ya kuongoza.

vi.L: Vậy bây giờ, lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của con, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã lập đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} làm vua thay cho Đa-vít cha con, nhưng con [chỉ là] một đứa trẻ nhỏ; con không biết đi ra đi vào.
vi.B: Bây giờ, lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của con, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã lập đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} làm vua thay cho Đa-vít cha con. Nhưng con chỉ là một đứa trẻ nhỏ, không biết cách đi ra đi vào để lãnh đạo dân.
vi.R: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của con, bây giờ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã lập con, là đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, làm vua thay cho Đa-vít cha con. Nhưng con như một đứa trẻ. Con không biết phải lãnh đạo thế nào.

ko.L: 그리고 이제 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 제 하나님, 주님께서 주님의 종을 제 아버지 다윗을 대신하여 왕으로 삼으셨습니다. 그러나 저는 작은 아이[입니다]. 저는 나가고 들어올 줄을 모릅니다.
ko.B: 이제 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 제 하나님, 주님께서 이 종을 제 아버지 다윗을 대신하여 왕으로 세우셨습니다. 그러나 저는 어린아이에 지나지 않아서, 백성을 어떻게 이끌어야 할지 모릅니다.
ko.R: 이제 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 제 하나님, 주님께서 주님의 종인 저를 제 아버지 다윗을 대신하여 왕으로 세우셨습니다. 그러나 저는 어린아이와 같아서 백성을 어떻게 이끌어야 할지 모릅니다.

pt.L: E agora, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, meu Deus, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} fizeste o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} servo rei em lugar de Davi, meu pai; mas eu [sou] um menino pequeno; não sei [como] sair nem entrar.
pt.B: Agora, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, meu Deus, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} fizeste o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} servo reinar no lugar do meu pai Davi. Mas eu sou apenas um menino; não sei sair e entrar à frente do povo, como um líder deve fazer.
pt.R: Agora, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, meu Deus, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} fizeste de mim, o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} servo, rei no lugar do meu pai Davi. Mas eu sou como uma criança pequena. Não sei liderar.

decisions.choice: to go out and to come in: to lead and to manage affairs
decisions.reason: To go out and come in is to carry on the whole of one's work, and for a leader to lead the people in war and in peace (Numbers 27:17; Deuteronomy 31:2; 1 Samuel 18:13, 16). 2 Chronicles 1:10 has Solomon ask for wisdom "that I may go out and come in before this people".

decisions.choice: a little boy: a humble way of speaking of himself
decisions.reason: The word can mean a boy or a young man. Solomon was not a small child: his son Rehoboam was forty-one when Solomon died after forty years as king (11:42; 14:21), so Solomon already had a son. He says how little he feels ready for the task (compare Jeremiah 1:6).

decisions.choice: your servant: a polite way of saying "me"
decisions.reason: Speaking of oneself as "your servant" was a common courtesy before a superior (Genesis 18:3; 1 Samuel 20:7). Solomon uses it of himself before God through verse 9.

decisions.choice: go out and come in as a leader (Balanced); lead (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced keeps the picture and adds what it means here; Readable says only what it means (m1).

decisions.choice: like a small child; me, your servant
decisions.reason: Readable says "like" so that the words are not read as Solomon's age (m2), and adds "me" so the polite "your servant" is clear.

decisions.choice: "SEÑOR" without the article in direct address
decisions.reason: Spoken to God, the name is the vocative "{{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}" without the article, as the Samuel notes set for Spanish.

decisions.choice: SEIGNEUR, without the article, in address
decisions.reason: The LORD addressed directly is "SEIGNEUR" without the article, as the French Samuel settles.

decisions.choice: "đi ra đi vào" (L, B)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew pair for leading and managing affairs (meaning decision); Balanced adds what it is for, and Readable says it plainly, as the English does.

decisions.choice: SENHOR (vocative, no article); o teu servo
decisions.reason: In the vocative the name has no article, "SENHOR, meu Deus", as prayer in 1 and 2 Samuel in Portuguese. Solomon names himself "o teu servo" to God (m3), the courtly third person with "tu", as David in 2 Samuel 7:19 in Portuguese; Readable adds "de mim", as the English adds "me".

source.text: וְעַ֨בְדְּךָ֔ בְּת֥וֹךְ עַמְּךָ֖ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בָּחָ֑רְתָּ עַם־רָ֕ב אֲשֶׁ֧ר לֹֽא־יִמָּנֶ֛ה וְלֹ֥א יִסָּפֵ֖ר מֵרֹֽב׃

records.literal_gloss: And your servant [is] in [the] midst of your people whom you have chosen, a people great, which not can be numbered and not can be counted for multitude.

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant [is] in the midst of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} people whom {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have chosen, a great people, who cannot be numbered and cannot be counted for multitude.
en.B: And {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant is here among {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} chosen people, a people so great that they cannot be numbered or counted.
en.R: And I, {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant, am among the people {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have chosen. They are so many that no one can count them.

es.L: Y {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} siervo [está] en medio de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} pueblo que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} escogiste, un pueblo grande, que no se puede contar ni numerar por su multitud.
es.B: Y {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} siervo está aquí en medio de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} pueblo escogido, un pueblo tan grande que no se puede contar ni numerar.
es.R: Y yo, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} siervo, estoy en medio del pueblo que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} escogiste. Son tantos que nadie los puede contar.

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur [est] au milieu de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} peuple que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as choisi, un peuple nombreux, qui ne peut être compté ni dénombré à cause de sa multitude.
fr.B: Et {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur se trouve au milieu du peuple que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as choisi, un peuple si nombreux qu’on ne peut ni le compter ni le dénombrer.
fr.R: Et moi, {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur, je suis au milieu du peuple que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as choisi. Ils sont si nombreux que personne ne peut les compter.

sw.L: Na mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} [yuko] katikati ya watu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} uliowachagua, watu wengi, wasioweza kuhesabika wala kutolewa idadi kwa wingi wao.
sw.B: Naye mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} yuko hapa miongoni mwa watu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} uliowachagua, taifa kubwa mno lisiloweza kuhesabika wala kutolewa idadi.
sw.R: Nami, mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}, niko miongoni mwa watu uliowachagua. Wao ni wengi mno hata hakuna mtu anayeweza kuwahesabu.

vi.L: Đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [đang ở] giữa dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã chọn, một dân lớn, không thể đếm, không thể tính được vì quá đông.
vi.B: Đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ở giữa dân mà {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã chọn, một dân đông đến nỗi không thể đếm hay tính được.
vi.R: Con, đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, đang ở giữa dân mà {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã chọn. Họ đông đến nỗi không ai đếm nổi.

ko.L: 그리고 주님의 종은 주님께서 택하신 주님의 백성 가운데 [있습니다]. 그들은 많아서 셀 수도 없고 헤아릴 수도 없는 큰 백성입니다.
ko.B: 이 종은 주님께서 택하신 주님의 백성 가운데 있습니다. 그들은 너무 많아서 셀 수도 없고 헤아릴 수도 없는 큰 백성입니다.
ko.R: 주님의 종인 저는 주님께서 택하신 백성 가운데 있습니다. 그들은 너무 많아서 아무도 셀 수 없습니다.

pt.L: E o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} servo [está] no meio do {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} povo, que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} escolheste, um povo grande, que não pode ser contado nem enumerado, de tão numeroso.
pt.B: E o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} servo está aqui no meio do {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} povo escolhido, um povo tão grande que não se pode contar nem calcular.
pt.R: E eu, o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} servo, estou no meio do povo que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} escolheste. Eles são tantos que ninguém consegue contá-los.

decisions.choice: a great people that cannot be counted: God's promise to Abraham kept
decisions.reason: Yahweh promised Abraham descendants as many as the dust of the earth and the stars of the sky, too many to count (Genesis 13:16; 15:5; 22:17). 4:20 says Judah and Israel were as many as the sand by the sea.

decisions.choice: your people whom you have chosen: Israel belongs to God
decisions.reason: Solomon calls Israel "your people" again and again (verses 8-9). They are Yahweh's chosen people (Deuteronomy 7:6), and the king serves them under him; he does not own them.

decisions.choice: your servant (all levels; Readable adds "I")
decisions.reason: As in verse 7.

source.text: וְנָתַתָּ֨ לְעַבְדְּךָ֜ לֵ֤ב שֹׁמֵ֨עַ֙ לִשְׁפֹּ֣ט אֶֽת־עַמְּךָ֔ לְהָבִ֖ין בֵּֽין־ט֣וֹב לְרָ֑ע כִּ֣י מִ֤י יוּכַל֙ לִשְׁפֹּ֔ט אֶת־עַמְּךָ֥ הַכָּבֵ֖ד הַזֶּֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And give to your servant a heart listening to judge your people, to discern between good and evil; for who is able to judge your people this heavy [one]?

en.L: So give {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant a listening heart to judge {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} people, to discern between good and evil; for who is able to judge this heavy people of {{deity_pronoun:yours|Yours}}?"
en.B: So give {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant a heart that listens, to judge {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} people and to tell good from evil. For who is able to judge so great a people as {{deity_pronoun:yours|Yours}}?"
en.R: So give me, {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant, a mind that truly listens, so that I can judge {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} people well and know the difference between right and wrong. Who could ever judge so many people of {{deity_pronoun:yours|Yours}}?"

es.L: Da, pues, a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} siervo un corazón que escuche, para juzgar a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} pueblo, para discernir entre el bien y el mal; porque ¿quién podrá juzgar a este {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} pueblo tan grande?».
es.B: Dale, pues, a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} siervo un corazón que sepa escuchar, para juzgar a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} pueblo y distinguir entre el bien y el mal. Porque ¿quién es capaz de juzgar a un pueblo tan grande como el {{deity_pronoun:tuyo|Tuyo}}?».
es.R: Dame, pues, a mí, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} siervo, una mente que de verdad escuche, para que pueda juzgar bien a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} pueblo y conocer la diferencia entre el bien y el mal. ¿Quién podría juzgar a un pueblo {{deity_pronoun:tuyo|Tuyo}} tan numeroso?».

fr.L: Donne donc à {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur un cœur qui écoute, pour juger {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} peuple, pour discerner entre le bien et le mal ; car qui pourrait juger {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} peuple, ce [peuple] si lourd ? »
fr.B: Donne donc à {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur un cœur qui écoute, pour juger {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} peuple et pour distinguer le bien du mal. Car qui pourrait juger un peuple aussi grand que le {{deity_pronoun:tien|Tien}} ? »
fr.R: Alors donne-moi, à moi, {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur, un esprit qui sache vraiment écouter, pour que je puisse bien juger {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} peuple et faire la différence entre le bien et le mal. Qui pourrait juger un peuple aussi nombreux que le {{deity_pronoun:tien|Tien}} ? »

sw.L: Basi mpe mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} moyo unaosikia, ili kuwahukumu watu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}, kupambanua kati ya mema na mabaya; kwa maana ni nani awezaye kuwahukumu watu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} hawa walio wazito?"
sw.B: Basi mpe mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} moyo unaosikiliza, ili awahukumu watu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} na kutofautisha mema na mabaya. Kwa maana ni nani awezaye kuwahukumu watu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} walio wengi namna hii?"
sw.R: Basi nipe mimi, mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}, akili inayosikiliza kweli, ili niwahukumu watu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} vizuri na kujua tofauti kati ya haki na kosa. Ni nani angeweza kuwaongoza watu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} walio wengi hivi?"

vi.L: Vậy xin ban cho đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} một tấm lòng biết lắng nghe để xét xử dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, để phân biệt giữa điều thiện và điều ác; vì ai có thể xét xử dân đông đảo này của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}?"
vi.B: Vậy xin ban cho đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} một tấm lòng biết lắng nghe để xét xử dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và phân biệt điều thiện với điều ác. Vì ai có thể xét xử một dân lớn như dân của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}?"
vi.R: Vậy xin ban cho con, đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, một tấm lòng thật sự biết lắng nghe, để con xét xử dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cho đúng và biết phân biệt điều phải điều trái. Ai có thể xét xử một dân đông như dân của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}?"

ko.L: 그러니 주님의 종에게 듣는 마음을 주셔서, 주님의 백성을 재판하고 선과 악을 분별하게 해 주십시오. 누가 주님의 이 무거운 백성을 재판할 수 있겠습니까?"
ko.B: 그러니 이 종에게 듣는 마음을 주셔서, 주님의 백성을 재판하고 선과 악을 가려낼 수 있게 해 주십시오. 그렇지 않으면 누가 이렇게 많은 주님의 백성을 재판할 수 있겠습니까?"
ko.R: 그러니 주님의 종인 저에게 잘 듣는 마음을 주십시오. 그래서 제가 주님의 백성을 바르게 재판하고 옳고 그른 것을 가려낼 수 있게 해 주십시오. 누가 이렇게 많은 주님의 백성을 재판할 수 있겠습니까?"

pt.L: Dá, pois, ao {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} servo um coração que ouve, para julgar o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} povo, para discernir entre o bem e o mal; pois quem é capaz de julgar este {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} povo tão pesado?"
pt.B: Dá, então, ao {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} servo um coração que ouve, para julgar o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} povo e distinguir entre o bem e o mal. Pois quem é capaz de julgar um povo tão grande como o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}}?"
pt.R: Por isso, dá a mim, o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} servo, uma mente que saiba ouvir de verdade, para que eu possa julgar bem o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} povo e saber a diferença entre o certo e o errado. Quem conseguiria julgar este povo {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}}, que é tão numeroso?"

decisions.choice: a listening heart: a mind that hears and understands
decisions.reason: In Hebrew the heart is the seat of thought and will, not only of feeling. A heart that listens hears both God and the people who bring their cases, understands what it hears, and acts on it. God answers with "a wise and discerning heart" (verse 12), and the two women's case shows it at work (verses 16-28).

decisions.choice: to judge: to govern and to settle disputes
decisions.reason: The king's judging includes ruling the people and deciding their cases with justice (verse 28; 2 Samuel 15:2-4).

decisions.choice: good and evil: right and wrong
decisions.reason: To discern between good and evil is to tell right from wrong, here in the cases a judge must decide (compare 2 Samuel 14:17).

decisions.choice: heavy: great in number and in weight
decisions.reason: The word means heavy. Said of a people it means numerous (verse 8), and it also suggests how weighty the task of judging them is.

decisions.choice: a heart that listens (Balanced); a mind that truly listens (Readable)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the picture word for word. Balanced keeps "heart" in a natural phrase; Readable says "mind", since for most readers the heart is only about feelings (m1).

decisions.choice: this great people (Balanced); so many people (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what "heavy" means here (m4).

decisions.choice: "un corazón que escuche" (L); "un corazón que sepa escuchar" (B); "una mente que de verdad escuche" (R)
decisions.reason: As the English (r-en-1): "heart" stays at Literal and Balanced; Readable says "mente", since the Hebrew heart is the seat of understanding.

decisions.choice: un esprit qui sache vraiment écouter
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced keep "cœur"; Readable says "esprit", as the English says "mind", since the heart here is the seat of understanding, not only of feeling.

decisions.choice: akili inayosikiliza kweli
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced keep "moyo" (heart); Readable says "akili" (mind), as the English Readable says "mind", since the heart here is the seat of understanding.

decisions.choice: "tấm lòng biết lắng nghe"
decisions.reason: In Vietnamese, as in Hebrew, "lòng" is where a person thinks and understands (the Psalms note's word), so it can keep the listening heart at every level where the English Readable says "mind".

decisions.choice: um coração que ouve (L, B); uma mente que saiba ouvir de verdade (R)
decisions.reason: The picture of a heart that listens (m1) is kept at Literal and Balanced, so that God's answer in verse 12, "um coração sábio e entendido", can be heard as its reply; "obediente" and "compreensivo" would each keep only half of what the listening heart does. Readable says "mente", as the English Readable says "mind", since "coração" in Portuguese also speaks mostly of feelings.

source.text: וַיִּיטַ֥ב הַדָּבָ֖ר בְּעֵינֵ֣י אֲדֹנָ֑י כִּ֚י שָׁאַ֣ל שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה אֶת־הַדָּבָ֖ר הַזֶּֽה׃

en.L: And the thing was good in the eyes of the Lord, that Solomon had asked this thing.
en.B: It pleased the Lord that Solomon had asked for this.
en.R: The Lord was pleased that Solomon had asked for this.

es.L: Y fue buena la cosa a los ojos del Señor, que Salomón hubiera pedido esto.
es.B: Al Señor le agradó que Salomón le pidiera esto.
es.R: Al Señor le gustó que Salomón le hubiera pedido esto.

fr.L: Et la chose fut bonne aux yeux du Seigneur, que Salomon eût demandé cette chose.
fr.B: Il plut au Seigneur que Salomon ait demandé cela.
fr.R: Le Seigneur a été content que Salomon lui ait demandé cela.

sw.L: Jambo hilo likawa jema machoni pa Bwana, kwamba Sulemani ameomba jambo hili.
sw.B: Ilimpendeza Bwana kwamba Sulemani aliomba jambo hili.
sw.R: Bwana alifurahi kwamba Sulemani aliomba jambo hili.

vi.L: Điều ấy là tốt trong mắt Chúa, vì Sa-lô-môn đã xin điều ấy.
vi.B: Chúa hài lòng vì Sa-lô-môn đã xin điều ấy.
vi.R: Chúa rất vui vì Sa-lô-môn đã xin điều ấy.

ko.L: 그리고 솔로몬이 이것을 구한 그 일이 주님의 눈에 좋았다.
ko.B: 솔로몬이 이것을 구한 것이 주님의 마음에 들었다.
ko.R: 솔로몬이 이것을 구하자 주님께서 기뻐하셨다.

pt.L: E a coisa foi boa aos olhos do Senhor, que Salomão tivesse pedido esta coisa.
pt.B: Agradou ao Senhor que Salomão tivesse pedido isso.
pt.R: O Senhor ficou contente porque Salomão tinha pedido isso.

decisions.choice: the Lord: the title, not the name
decisions.reason: Here and in verse 15 the text has the title "Lord" (Adonai), the word Israel later read aloud in place of the name Yahweh. It refers to Yahweh, who spoke in verse 5.

decisions.choice: was good in the eyes of: pleased
decisions.reason: To be good in someone's eyes is to please him. What pleased the Lord is spelled out in verse 11: Solomon asked for the gift to serve others, not for himself.

decisions.choice: the Lord
decisions.reason: "Lord" with only a capital L is used for the title, so that it is not confused with the divine name, which is never "Lord" alone.

decisions.choice: "el Señor" (no divine_name span)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew here is the title Adonai, not the name, so Spanish says "el Señor" in ordinary letters without a span, as the English does (r-en-1).

decisions.choice: le Seigneur
decisions.reason: Adonai, the title, is "le Seigneur" in ordinary letters, kept apart from the divine name "le SEIGNEUR".

decisions.choice: Bwana
decisions.reason: The title *Adonai* is "Bwana" with only a capital B, so that it is not confused with the divine name, written "BWANA" in capitals, as in the Swahili Pentateuch.

decisions.choice: "Chúa"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew has the title *Adonai*, not the name (meaning decision); the Genesis note writes it "Chúa", without capitals and without the span.

decisions.choice: "주님" for *Adonai*
decisions.reason: The Hebrew has the title Lord here, not the name; as the Korean style guide, *Adonai* is 주님 and takes no divine_name span.

decisions.choice: o Senhor
decisions.reason: The title Adonai (m1) is "o Senhor", with only a capital S and no setting, as in the Old Testament terms, so that it is not taken for the divine name.

source.text: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֱלֹהִ֜ים אֵלָ֗יו יַעַן֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר שָׁאַ֜לְתָּ אֶת־הַדָּבָ֣ר הַזֶּ֗ה וְלֹֽא־שָׁאַ֨לְתָּ לְּךָ֜ יָמִ֣ים רַבִּ֗ים וְלֹֽא־שָׁאַ֤לְתָּ לְּךָ֙ עֹ֔שֶׁר וְלֹ֥א שָׁאַ֖לְתָּ נֶ֣פֶשׁ אֹיְבֶ֑יךָ וְשָׁאַ֧לְתָּ לְּךָ֛ הָבִ֖ין לִשְׁמֹ֥עַ מִשְׁפָּֽט׃

records.literal_gloss: And said God to him, Because that you asked this thing and not you asked for yourself days many and not you asked for yourself wealth and not you asked [the] life of your enemies, and you asked for yourself discernment to hear justice,

en.L: And God said to him, "Because you have asked this thing, and have not asked for yourself many days, and have not asked for yourself wealth, and have not asked for the life of your enemies, but have asked for yourself discernment to hear justice,
en.B: So God said to him, "Because you have asked for this, and have not asked for a long life for yourself, or wealth, or the death of your enemies, but have asked for understanding so that you can listen to cases and judge them justly,
en.R: So God said to him, "You did not ask to live a long time. You did not ask to be rich. You did not ask {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} to kill your enemies. Instead, you asked for wisdom so that you can listen well and judge people fairly.

es.L: Y le dijo Dios: «Porque has pedido esto, y no pediste para ti muchos días, ni pediste para ti riquezas, ni pediste la vida de tus enemigos, sino que pediste para ti discernimiento para oír juicio,
es.B: Entonces Dios le dijo: «Porque has pedido esto, y no has pedido para ti una larga vida, ni riquezas, ni la muerte de tus enemigos, sino que has pedido entendimiento para escuchar los casos y juzgarlos con justicia,
es.R: Entonces Dios le dijo: «No pediste vivir mucho tiempo. No pediste ser rico. No me pediste que matara a tus enemigos. En cambio, pediste sabiduría para que puedas escuchar bien y juzgar a la gente con justicia.

fr.L: Et Dieu lui dit : « Parce que tu as demandé cette chose, et que tu n’as pas demandé pour toi de nombreux jours, et que tu n’as pas demandé pour toi la richesse, et que tu n’as pas demandé la vie de tes ennemis, mais que tu as demandé pour toi le discernement pour écouter le droit,
fr.B: Dieu lui dit alors : « Puisque c’est là ce que tu as demandé, et que tu n’as demandé pour toi ni une longue vie, ni la richesse, ni la mort de tes ennemis, mais l’intelligence pour écouter les causes et juger avec droiture,
fr.R: Alors Dieu lui a dit : « Tu n’as pas demandé de vivre longtemps. Tu n’as pas demandé d’être riche. Tu ne {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}as pas demandé de faire mourir tes ennemis. Au contraire, tu as demandé la sagesse pour bien écouter et juger les gens avec justice.

sw.L: Mungu akamwambia, "Kwa sababu umeomba jambo hili, wala hukujiombea siku nyingi, wala hukujiombea mali, wala hukuomba roho za adui zako, bali umejiombea ufahamu wa kusikia hukumu,
sw.B: Basi Mungu akamwambia, "Kwa sababu umeomba jambo hili, wala hukujiombea maisha marefu, wala mali, wala kifo cha adui zako, bali umeomba ufahamu ili upate kusikiliza mashauri na kuyaamua kwa haki,
sw.R: Basi Mungu akamwambia, "Hukuomba kuishi muda mrefu. Hukuomba kuwa tajiri. Hukuniomba niwaue adui zako. Badala yake, umeomba hekima ili upate kusikiliza vizuri na kuwahukumu watu kwa haki.

vi.L: Đức Chúa Trời phán với vua: "Vì ngươi đã xin điều này, mà không xin cho mình sống lâu, không xin cho mình giàu có, cũng không xin mạng sống của kẻ thù ngươi, nhưng đã xin cho mình sự thông sáng để nghe [và xử] công minh,
vi.B: Vậy Đức Chúa Trời phán với vua: "Vì con đã xin điều này, mà không xin cho mình được sống lâu, giàu có hay mạng sống của kẻ thù, nhưng đã xin sự thông sáng để biết lắng nghe và xét xử công minh,
vi.R: Vậy Đức Chúa Trời phán với vua: "Con đã không xin được sống lâu. Con đã không xin được giàu có. Con cũng không xin Ta giết các kẻ thù của con. Trái lại, con đã xin sự khôn ngoan để biết lắng nghe và xét xử dân công bằng.

ko.L: 그리고 하나님께서 그에게 말씀하셨다. "네가 이것을 구하고, 너를 위하여 많은 날을 구하지 않고, 너를 위하여 부를 구하지 않고, 네 원수들의 목숨을 구하지 않고, 너를 위하여 재판을 듣는 분별력을 구했으므로,
ko.B: 그래서 하나님께서 그에게 말씀하셨다. "네가 이것을 구했다. 너를 위해 오래 살기를 구하지 않았고, 부유해지기를 구하지도 않았으며, 원수들의 죽음을 구하지도 않았다. 오히려 소송을 듣고 바르게 재판할 수 있는 분별력을 구했다.
ko.R: 그래서 하나님께서 그에게 말씀하셨다. "너는 오래 살게 해 달라고 구하지 않았다. 부자가 되게 해 달라고 구하지도 않았다. 네 원수들을 죽여 달라고 구하지도 않았다. 그 대신에 너는 사람들의 말을 잘 듣고 공정하게 재판할 수 있는 지혜를 구했다.

pt.L: E Deus lhe disse: "Porque pediste esta coisa, e não pediste para ti muitos dias, e não pediste para ti riqueza, e não pediste a vida dos teus inimigos, mas pediste para ti discernimento para ouvir a justiça,
pt.B: Então Deus lhe disse: "Porque pediste isto, e não pediste para ti uma vida longa, nem riqueza, nem a morte dos teus inimigos, mas pediste entendimento para ouvir as causas e julgá-las com justiça,
pt.R: Então Deus disse a ele: "Tu não pediste para viver muito tempo. Não pediste para ficar rico. Não {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} pediste para matar os teus inimigos. Em vez disso, pediste sabedoria para saber ouvir e julgar as pessoas com justiça.

decisions.choice: many days: a long life
decisions.reason: Many days is the usual way of speaking of a long life (verse 14; Deuteronomy 30:20).

decisions.choice: the life of your enemies: their death
decisions.reason: To ask for someone's life is to ask that he be put to death. The three things Solomon did not ask for are the usual wishes of kings: long life, riches and victory over their foes.

decisions.choice: discernment to hear justice: the understanding to hear cases rightly
decisions.reason: "To hear" picks up the listening heart of verse 9: a judge hears the case and decides it with justice. The word for justice also means a judgment or a legal case.

decisions.choice: Because ... , (the sentence continues in verse 12)
decisions.reason: God's sentence runs into the next verse, where the main clause comes: "I am doing as you asked". Literal and Balanced end this verse with a comma; Readable makes short sentences of its own.

decisions.choice: did not ask ... to kill your enemies
decisions.reason: Readable says what asking for the life of enemies means (m2).

decisions.choice: Verse 11 closed as its own sentence at Balanced
alternatives: one sentence running into verse 12, as Literal
decisions.reason: Korean puts the main verb last; closing the "because" clause at the verse keeps God's answer under verse 12's number, as the English Readable does.

source.text: הִנֵּ֥ה עָשִׂ֖יתִי כִּדְבָרֶ֑יךָ הִנֵּ֣ה׀נָתַ֣תִּי לְךָ֗ לֵ֚ב חָכָ֣ם וְנָב֔וֹן אֲשֶׁ֤ר כָּמ֨וֹךָ֙ לֹא־הָיָ֣ה לְפָנֶ֔יךָ וְאַחֲרֶ֖יךָ לֹא־יָק֥וּם כָּמֽוֹךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: Here, I have done according to your words; here, I have given to you a heart wise and discerning, so that like you not there has been before you, and after you not will arise like you.

en.L: See, I am doing according to your words; see, I am giving you a wise and discerning heart, so that there has been none like you before you, and after you none like you will arise.
en.B: So I will do what you have asked. I am giving you a wise and discerning heart. No one before you has been like you, and no one after you will ever rise up who is like you.
en.R: So I will do what you asked. I am giving you a wise and understanding mind. There has never been anyone like you, and there will never be anyone like you again.

es.L: he aquí, hago conforme a tus palabras; he aquí, te doy un corazón sabio y entendido, de manera que no ha habido otro como tú antes de ti, ni después de ti se levantará otro como tú.
es.B: por eso haré lo que me has pedido. Te doy un corazón sabio y entendido. Nadie antes de ti ha sido como tú, y nadie después de ti se levantará que sea como tú.
es.R: Por eso haré lo que pediste. Te doy una mente sabia y entendida. Nunca ha habido nadie como tú, y nunca volverá a haber nadie como tú.

fr.L: voici, je fais selon tes paroles ; voici, je te donne un cœur sage et intelligent, de sorte qu’il n’y en a pas eu de semblable à toi avant toi, et après toi il ne s’en lèvera pas de semblable à toi.
fr.B: je vais donc faire ce que tu as demandé. Je te donne un cœur sage et intelligent. Personne avant toi n’a été comme toi, et personne après toi ne se lèvera qui soit comme toi.
fr.R: Alors je vais faire ce que tu as demandé. Je te donne un esprit sage et intelligent. Il n’y a jamais eu personne comme toi, et il n’y aura plus jamais personne comme toi.

sw.L: tazama, ninafanya sawasawa na maneno yako; tazama, ninakupa moyo wa hekima na ufahamu, hata hapajakuwa na mtu kama wewe kabla yako, wala baada yako hatainuka mtu kama wewe.
sw.B: basi nitafanya ulichoomba. Ninakupa moyo wenye hekima na ufahamu. Kabla yako hapajakuwa na mtu kama wewe, wala baada yako hatainuka mtu kama wewe.
sw.R: Basi nitafanya ulichoomba. Ninakupa akili yenye hekima na ufahamu. Hapajawahi kuwa na mtu kama wewe, wala hatakuwepo mtu kama wewe tena.

vi.L: Này, Ta làm theo lời ngươi; này, Ta ban cho ngươi một tấm lòng khôn ngoan và thông sáng, đến nỗi trước ngươi không có ai như ngươi, và sau ngươi cũng sẽ không có ai như ngươi.
vi.B: Vậy Ta sẽ làm theo điều con xin. Ta ban cho con một tấm lòng khôn ngoan và thông sáng. Trước con chưa từng có ai như con, và sau con cũng sẽ không bao giờ có ai như con.
vi.R: Vậy Ta sẽ làm theo điều con xin. Ta ban cho con một tấm lòng khôn ngoan và hiểu biết. Chưa từng có ai như con, và sau này cũng sẽ không bao giờ có ai như con.

ko.L: 보아라, 내가 네 말대로 하겠다. 보아라, 내가 네게 지혜롭고 분별하는 마음을 준다. 그래서 네 앞에 너와 같은 사람이 없었고, 네 뒤에도 너와 같은 사람이 일어나지 않을 것이다.
ko.B: 그러므로 내가 네가 구한 대로 해 주겠다. 내가 네게 지혜롭고 분별력 있는 마음을 준다. 너보다 앞서 너와 같은 사람이 없었고, 네 뒤에도 너와 같은 사람이 다시는 나오지 않을 것이다.
ko.R: 그러므로 나는 네가 구한 대로 해 주겠다. 내가 너에게 지혜롭고 슬기로운 마음을 준다. 너와 같은 사람은 전에도 없었고, 앞으로도 다시는 없을 것이다.

pt.L: Eis que faço conforme as tuas palavras; eis que te dou um coração sábio e entendido, de modo que antes de ti não houve ninguém como tu, e depois de ti não se levantará ninguém como tu.
pt.B: Por isso farei o que pediste. Eu te dou um coração sábio e entendido. Antes de ti não houve ninguém como tu, e depois de ti nunca se levantará outro igual a ti.
pt.R: Por isso vou fazer o que pediste. Eu te dou uma mente sábia e capaz de entender. Nunca houve ninguém como tu, e nunca mais haverá outro igual.

decisions.choice: I am doing; I am giving: done as God speaks
decisions.reason: The verbs are in the form for a finished act. God speaks of the gift as already given: his word makes it so.

decisions.choice: a wise and discerning heart: the answer to Solomon's request
decisions.reason: God gives more than "a listening heart" (verse 9): a heart that is wise and able to understand. The same pair of words describes the leader Joseph advised Pharaoh to find (Genesis 41:33, 39). Solomon's wisdom is described in 5:9-14.

decisions.choice: none like you before or after: Solomon's wisdom is without equal
decisions.reason: The promise is about wisdom. Similar words are said of Hezekiah's trust in Yahweh (2 Kings 18:5) and of Josiah's turning to him (2 Kings 23:25), each in its own way.

decisions.choice: See
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word draws attention to what follows. Literal says "See"; Balanced and Readable show it by "So" and by the present tense.

decisions.choice: mind
decisions.reason: As in verse 9, Readable says "mind" for heart.

decisions.choice: um coração sábio e entendido (L, B); uma mente sábia e capaz de entender (R)
decisions.reason: "Entendido" says one who understands and can tell things apart (m2), and it pairs with "um coração que ouve" in verse 9; "inteligente" is narrower, and "prudente" names caution. Readable keeps "mente", as in verse 9.

source.text: וְגַ֨ם אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹֽא־שָׁאַ֨לְתָּ֙ נָתַ֣תִּי לָ֔ךְ גַּם־עֹ֖שֶׁר גַּם־כָּב֑וֹד אֲ֠שֶׁר לֹא־הָיָ֨ה כָמ֥וֹךָ אִ֛ישׁ בַּמְּלָכִ֖ים כָּל־יָמֶֽיךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: And also what not you asked I have given to you, both wealth and honor, so that not there has been like you a man among the kings all your days.

en.L: And also what you have not asked I am giving you, both wealth and honor, so that there will not be a man like you among the kings all your days.
en.B: I am also giving you what you did not ask for: both wealth and honor. As long as you live, no other king will be your equal.
en.R: I will also give you what you did not ask for. I will make you rich and honored. As long as you live, no other king will be as great as you.

es.L: Y también lo que no pediste te doy: riquezas y gloria, de modo que no habrá hombre como tú entre los reyes en todos tus días.
es.B: También te doy lo que no pediste: riquezas y gloria. Mientras vivas, ningún otro rey será igual a ti.
es.R: También te daré lo que no pediste. Te haré rico y famoso. Mientras vivas, ningún otro rey será tan grande como tú.

fr.L: Et aussi ce que tu n’as pas demandé, je te le donne, et la richesse et la gloire, de sorte qu’il n’y aura pas d’homme semblable à toi parmi les rois tous tes jours.
fr.B: Je te donne aussi ce que tu n’as pas demandé : la richesse et la gloire. Tant que tu vivras, aucun autre roi ne sera ton égal.
fr.R: Je te donnerai aussi ce que tu n’as pas demandé. Je te rendrai riche et honoré. Tant que tu vivras, aucun autre roi ne sera aussi grand que toi.

sw.L: Tena nimekupa hata yale usiyoyaomba, mali na heshima, hata hapatakuwa na mtu kama wewe miongoni mwa wafalme siku zako zote.
sw.B: Ninakupa pia yale usiyoyaomba: mali na heshima. Maisha yako yote hapatakuwa na mfalme mwingine anayelingana nawe.
